### His Hands Raised High
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-5-2025.html
Passage: Luke 24:50-51
Points:
- Jesus' earthly life was a purposeful journey toward His planned return to heavenly glory.
- His visible departure removed uncertainty, confirming that His saving mission had been accomplished.
- Raising His hands in departure was a traditional sign of lasting care over His people.
- Christ, who bore the cross, continues to delight in extending His blessing to believers.

### Ascension and Session
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ascension-and-session
Passage: Mark 16:19
Points:
- The fundamental confession of the Christian faith is the universal lordship of Jesus Christ.
- Ascending and taking His seat at the Father's right hand inaugurated Christ's cosmic rule.
- Having fulfilled His redemptive mission, the God-man received supreme authority over all creation.
- While Christians must respect earthly authorities, Christ alone commands our absolute allegiance.
